inputs.share_count_basis: 1,034,334,286 shares in issue at 30 Jun 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim, Disclosure of Interests note) less 1,398,000 repurchased-in-H1 shares cancelled 10 Aug 2026 and 10,950,000 repurchased-and-cancelled in July 2026 (interim 'Other and Subsequent Events') = 1,021.99m; plus ~15.3m share options outstanding at HKD 3.26 (15.927m at 31 Dec 2025 less ~0.6m exercised in H1) on the treasury-stock method at the current price = ~9.5m net dilutive shares. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows (tiny, 0.1% of revenue); buybacks are the mechanism that keeps the count flat and are value-neutral in this model.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement, 'Equity-settled share-based payment expenses' USD1,067k (0975.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:4427); no cash taxes on equity awards disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes 0 in kpis). Interest income (USD10.5m FY2025) is NOT deducted: the company is net-debt, not net-cash, and the component build starts from adjusted EBITDA which excludes finance income, so cash is netted once in the bridge.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing outflow USD18.3m for share buyback (FY2025 AR cash-flow note 2). H1 FY2026 USD5.3m (4,524,000 shares); July 2026 a further USD9.4m (10,950,000 shares, cancelled). The company is a genuine repurchaser, so the flat count is funded, not a convention. No dividends paid in any year FY2018-FY2025.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and all flows are in USD (Cayman-incorporated, USD functional currency, USD Senior Notes); the HKEX quote is in HKD. USD/HKD 7.8472 from Yahoo Finance HKD=X at 2026-10-09 (the date of the price close). HKD is pegged to USD in a 7.75-7.85 band, so the rate carries no material FX judgment and the band itself is the parity check; there is no dual listing to cross-check against. All per-share values are computed in USD and multiplied by fx_rate into HKD; unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are in HKD to match current_price.
inputs.net_debt_note: At 30 Jun 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim, consolidated statement of financial position): Senior Notes due 2030 at PRINCIPAL USD350.0m (carrying USD344.6m; the obligation is the principal), EM bank borrowing USD50.0m (USD40.0m outstanding at the Aug 2026 report date, but the 30 Jun balance is used so cash and debt are same-dated), lease liabilities USD0.13m = total debt USD400.1m. Cash USD294.4m at 30 Jun less the USD9.4m July 2026 buyback (whose shares are already removed from the count) = USD285.0m. Net debt USD115.1m. Perpetual notes were fully repurchased in FY2024 (balance nil at FY2024, FY2025 and H1 FY2026) and are no longer a claim. The USD6.0m final UCC deferred consideration (due Mar 2027) sits in trade payables and is left in working capital (immaterial).
inputs.wacc_rationale: Flows are USD, so WACC is built from USD inputs: 10-year UST ~4.2% + 5.0% ERP x beta 1.2 = 10.2% base cost of equity, plus ~3pp Mongolia sovereign/governance premium (Mongolia B/B+ sovereign; the company's own 8.44% 2030 notes at ~0.5x net debt/EBITDA show the market charging ~4pp of country premium on the debt) = ~13.2% cost of equity. Cost of debt 8.44% pre-tax, ~6.6% after 22% tax. Weights at market: equity ~USD1.13bn, debt USD0.40bn -> 74/26. WACC = 0.74 x 13.2 + 0.26 x 6.6 = 11.5%, used identically across all three scenarios. Division of labour (risk charged once): coal-price cyclicality, the Strategic Deposit outcome, gold-price and ramp risk live in the SCENARIO FLOWS and their weights; sovereign and governance (controlling-shareholder related-party) risk lives in the discount rate. No per-scenario WACC differences.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) leases as debt: lease liabilities (USD0.13m at 30 Jun 2026) are in total_debt; no lease charge in the flows (lease_cost_pct_path 0). Leases are immaterial for this company (owned fleet, mine-site infrastructure).
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is charged ONCE, in the flows, not in the bridge. Minorities are the 50% partner in Erdene Mongol (Bayan Khundii gold; commercial production Sep 2025) and the 49.5% partner in Universal Copper (copper/silver, exploration stage). The gold JV is the only NCI with earnings, and its share of group profit scales with gold's contribution, so it is folded into cash_tax_rate_path as a combined tax-plus-leakage rate: ~21% cash CIT (FY2023-25 cash tax paid / PBT = 19.3%; statutory 25% above MNT6bn) plus 50% of after-tax gold EBIT, which is ~14pp of group EBIT at mid-cycle (gold ~35% of EBIT because coal EBIT is depressed by stripping amortisation) -> 35% combined from FY2028 in base. Calibration: H1 FY2026 NCI share of profit USD16.9m vs gold segment profit USD32.2m x 50% = USD16.1m, ties. The NCI balance (USD174.6m) is therefore NOT deducted in the bridge. Group capex carries 100% of gold sustaining capex although the partner funds half; that is ~USD5-8m/yr of conservatism, left in.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, scenario-weighted (dcf-methods routing row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical' + owner-fcf-adaptations: currency, NCI, risk-charged-once, cyclical terminal cap). First valuation of this ticker; no MEMORY entry. WHY THIS MODEL: MMC is an operating coking-coal miner (plus a new gold mine) whose value is a stream of free cash flow; it is not a bank, REIT, holdco or distressed shell. The cyclical adaptation is the whole judgment here: FY0 (FY2025) was a trough year (coal ASP USD82.2/t, adj. EBITDA margin 24.7%, owner FCF ~USD5m after a USD53m gold-mine build), FY2023-24 were peak years (ASP USD105-121/t, margins 46-48%), and H1 FY2026 is mid-recovery (ASP USD90.9/t, margin 28.9%, gold 30% of EBITDA). Driver paths are set to MID-CYCLE levels, not to FY0 or to the peak: base coal revenue/t ~USD92 (ASP ~USD95) against a FY2019-H1 FY2026 average of ~USD106 and the FY2025 trough of USD78; coal cash cost ~USD65/t (H1 FY2026 actual); gold at USD3,300/oz long-term (reserve estimate uses USD3,900; spot ~USD4,000) at 75-80koz vs 85koz nameplate. CAPEX includes deferred stripping (USD128m FY2025, capitalised in investing) which is the business's true sustaining cost and the reason FCF conversion of EBITDA runs ~30-40% (FY2023-H1 FY2026 cumulative: EBITDA USD1,349m -> FCF USD480m = 36%). Base FCF conversion is ~30%, below history, because the base also carries a ~1.5pp special-royalty cost from FY2028 (the Feb 2026 MoU route) and the NCI leakage on gold that did not exist before FY2026. Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC; SBC is 0.1% of revenue and kept visible. Interest in associates (USD18.4m book) is added in the equity_bridge because share-of-associate profit is not in EBITDA (matching-asset rule). Universal Copper (White Hill/Urkhut) is carried at ZERO in base and bear - exploration stage, no cash flows; bull gives it late-horizon growth and capex. Terminal cap multiple 12x base / 13x bull / 10x bear per the method's 12-15x guidance for cyclicals; terminal growth 2.0/2.5/1.5%. Band position is reported but near-degenerate (SBC ~0.1% of revenue): house and street coincide to within ~1%.

equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 statement of financial position, 30 Jun 2026; share of associate profit (~USD2m/yr) is excluded from EBITDA so the asset is added once here

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 10-year revenue CAGR FY2025->FY2035 (cycle-normalised recovery from the FY2025 trough to mid-cycle, then 1-3%/yr). None of the historical CAGRs is usable as a forward rate: FY2022->FY2025 and FY2020->FY2025 both start near a trough and end at a trough, so revenue CAGRs are flattered by volume growth while EPS and FCF CAGRs are destroyed by the FY2025 ASP collapse.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (+12.3% 3yr / +8.5% 5yr) diverges by far more than 30% from EPS (-53% / -27%) and owner-FCF (-68% / -34%) CAGRs. This is cycle-endpoint noise, not a trend: FY2025 net income was USD6.1m vs USD242.0m in FY2024 on a 32% coal ASP decline, and FY2025 FCF absorbed the USD53m Bayan Khundii build. Revenue swung USD184m (FY2021) -> USD1,035m (FY2023) -> USD823m (FY2025). The model therefore uses mid-cycle driver levels rather than any CAGR.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC; interest income not deducted as the company is net-debt): FY2018 68.4, FY2019 71.6, FY2020 40.1, FY2021 36.7, FY2022 153.4, FY2023 345.9, FY2024 32.7, FY2025 5.0 (USDm). SBC is 0.0-0.4% of revenue every year, so owner and reported FCF CAGRs are within ~2pp; SBC is not a growing share of cash flow here.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 (+37%): H1 actual USD586m plus an H2 of ~USD540m (coal ASP softening from H1's USD90.9/t per management's 'challenging' outlook, offset by a full half of gold at ~25koz) = ~USD1,128m. FY2027 (+16%) is the step to mid-cycle: coal 11.5Mt (FY2025 10.1Mt, H1 FY2026 run-rate 11.4Mt, rail displacing trucks) at ~USD92/t revenue (ASP ~USD95; FY2019-H1 FY2026 average ~USD106, FY2025 trough USD78) = ~USD1,058m; gold 75koz at USD3,300/oz plus silver = ~USD248m. Thereafter 1-3%/yr: coal volume creeps with rail capacity while China steel output declines ~3%/yr; gold flat at ~80koz then fades from FY2034 as Bayan Khundii reserves deplete without Dark Horse/AN extension credited.
base.margin_rationale: Coal EBITDA ~USD27/t (revenue/t USD92 less ~USD65/t cash cost incl. S&D and G&A, H1 FY2026 actual cost base) on 11.5Mt = ~USD310m (29%); gold ~45% margin at USD3,300/oz and ~USD1,800/oz cash cost = ~USD113m; group 32% in FY2027. From FY2028 a ~1.5pp cost for the Feb 2026 MoU's market-price-linked special royalty on the Strategic Deposit licences (base assumes the royalty-for-equity swap IS ratified). Fades to 30% by FY2035 as gold grade and share of mix decline. For reference: FY2018-25 average adj. EBITDA margin 35.7% (two peak years inside), FY2025 trough 24.7%, H1 FY2026 28.9%.
base.capex_da_rationale: Capex = deferred stripping (USD128m FY2025, USD67m H1 FY2026; scales with ROM volume) + sustaining PP&E (~USD50-60m/yr trucks, CHPP, infrastructure) + gold sustaining; the USD108m Bayan Khundii build (FY2024-25) is complete (H1 FY2026 BKH capex USD2.8m) and is NOT carried forward. 15.5% FY2026 (H1 actual USD88.5m on USD586m), 16% mid-cycle, 15% late. D&A 12.5% -> 12% (FY2024 12.0%, FY2025 14.8% on trough revenue; H1 FY2026 USD70.5m incl. gold). Capex exceeds D&A by ~4pp because stripping is capitalised ahead of the coal it uncovers and volumes are growing.
base.tax_rationale: Combined cash tax + NCI leakage on EBIT. FY2026 25% (H1 FY2026 cash tax paid USD7.8m vs USD24m expense - lag), FY2027 30% (new three-tier CIT regime effective 2027, assumed roughly neutral; gold NCI growing), FY2028+ 35% = ~21% cash CIT + ~14pp for the 50% Erdene Mongol partner's share of after-tax gold EBIT. See inputs.nci_treatment.
base.narrative: Mid-cycle base: coal ASP recovers from the FY2025 trough toward but not back to its historical average, because China's steel output is in structural decline even as Mongolia takes a record 60%+ share of China's coking coal imports. Rail lifts volume to 11.5Mt. Bayan Khundii reaches ~75-80koz at a long-term gold price well below spot. Parliament ratifies the Feb 2026 MoU so the Strategic Deposit claim becomes a special royalty (charged ~1.5pp of revenue) rather than free state equity. Universal Copper is worth nothing in this case.

bull.narrative: Coal ASP returns to its FY2019-FY2024 average (~USD105/t, revenue/t ~USD100) as Chinese domestic coking coal production keeps falling and Mongolia's import share holds above 60%; rail takes sales to 12.5Mt by FY2028. Gold holds the USD3,900/oz reserve-case price with Bayan Khundii at 85koz nameplate and Dark Horse/AN extending mine life. The MoU is ratified as a modest royalty (~1pp). White Hill copper advances to development from FY2028, adding capex (17%) now and growth later. Coal EBITDA ~USD35/t x 12.5Mt plus gold ~55% margin gives a 36% group margin, still below the FY2023-24 peak 46-48%. Higher gold share means more NCI leakage (34% combined).
bull.growth_rationale: FY2026 +40% (H2 holds H1's ASP), FY2027 +22% (12Mt x ~USD100/t coal + 85koz x USD3,900 gold), then 2-6%.
bull.margin_rationale: Still ~10pp below the FY2023-24 peak; this is a historical-average coal price, not a peak.

bear.narrative: Coal ASP falls back to the FY2025 trough (~USD80/t, revenue/t ~USD78-80) and stays there as China steel output keeps contracting and Chinese mills lean on domestic supply; volume stalls at ~10.5Mt. Gold reverts to USD2,800/oz and Bayan Khundii plateaus at 65koz with no Dark Horse extension, so revenue fades from FY2031. The decisive bear axis is regulatory: the MoU is not ratified and the State exercises its Minerals Law / National Wealth Fund Law right to a free equity stake (modelled as ~34% of the UHG/BN licence holders) from FY2028, so roughly half the coal profit pool leaks to the State on top of CIT and the gold partner's share -> 50% combined leakage on EBIT. The 2027 CIT regime change is adverse. Universal Copper is worth nothing. Margins (22-23%) sit at the FY2022/FY2025 trough levels (24.5%/24.7%) less the cost of a weaker gold price.
bear.growth_rationale: FY2026 +30% (H2 ~USD484m, coal back to ~USD82/t and gold off its H1 price), FY2027 -8%, flat, then -1 to -2%/yr as gold depletes.
bear.margin_rationale: Coal ~USD14/t EBITDA (USD79 revenue/t less USD65 cash cost) x 10.5Mt = ~USD145m (17%); gold 65koz at USD2,800 and ~35% margin = ~USD64m; group ~21-23%.

scenario_narratives.base: Mid-cycle coal (ASP ~USD95/t, 11.5Mt by rail), gold at USD3,300/oz and 75-80koz, MoU ratified as a ~1.5pp special royalty, copper at zero. The company earns ~USD420m EBITDA mid-cycle and converts ~30% of it to owner FCF after capitalised stripping and the gold partner's share. Value is dominated by the explicit years (terminal <45% of EV) because the 12x cap and 11.5% WACC keep the exit multiple at what a cyclical miner actually trades on.
scenario_narratives.bull: Coal price mean-reverts to its 2019-2024 average, Mongolia keeps a 60%+ share of China's imports, gold stays near USD3,900 with mine-life extension, the Strategic Deposit claim is settled benignly, and White Hill copper becomes a second new mine. Several independent things must go right at once, which is why the weight is 20%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Coal stuck at the FY2025 trough, gold back to USD2,800, and the State takes a free equity stake in the coal licences from FY2028 instead of a royalty. The business survives (no scenario hits the zero floor; net debt/EBITDA stays ~0.5x on the 8.44% notes) but roughly half of coal profit no longer belongs to MMC shareholders.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: MMC is a single-commodity price-taker selling ~100% of its coal into one country through one border crossing, with a live, unratified claim by a single regulator (the Mongolian State) to up to 50% free equity in both core mines, plus a controlling shareholder (MCS Group, ~31%) on the other side of most of its service contracts - three of the method's named triggers for a higher bear weight. Bull cut to 20% because it needs coal ASP, gold price, MoU ratification and copper development to all go right independently. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street bases coincide to within ~1% because SBC is ~0.1% of revenue (SBC-near-zero issuer); the house/street band is ~HKD0.09 wide and the current price sits far outside it, so band_position is not meaningful and is reported as null rather than as the degenerate ~1300% the formula yields.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Through-cycle owner-FCF DCF of a cyclical Mongolian coking coal miner with a new 50%-owned gold mine. FY0 is a trough, so no driver is anchored to FY0 margins or FCF; coal is priced at a mid-cycle ASP below its historical average (China steel is structurally shrinking), gold below spot, and the capitalised deferred stripping that IFRS books in investing is treated as the sustaining cost it is. Risk is charged once: cyclicality and the Strategic Deposit outcome in the scenario flows and weights, sovereign and governance risk in a single 11.5% USD WACC. The terminal value is capped at 10-13x FCF so the model never assumes a re-rating a coal miner does not get.
key_risks_to_valuation: Strategic Deposit designation: the Feb 2026 MoU (royalty instead of free State equity) is non-binding and unratified; a free 34-50% State stake in UHG/BN is the bear case and roughly halves coal value to shareholders
Coking coal ASP: every USD10/t on 11.5Mt is ~USD115m of EBITDA (~27% of base EBITDA); China crude steel output fell 4.4% in 2025 and 3.0% in H1 2026
Gold price and Bayan Khundii ramp: base uses USD3,300/oz vs ~USD4,000 spot; the segment is 50% owned so only half its value accrues to MMC
Related-party dependence on MCS Group (power, security, camp, logistics, marketing) - governance discount carried in WACC, not quantified in flows
Deferred stripping intensity: if the stripping ratio rises, capex at 16% of revenue is too low; each 1pp is ~USD13m/yr of FCF
Single border crossing (Gashuunsukhait/Ganqimaodu) and Chinese import policy; FY2021 showed revenue can fall 56% on a border closure
USD-denominated 8.44% notes against RMB coal and MNT gold revenue
